title: Buddy ECC: Making Cache Mostly Clean in CXL-Based Memory Systems for Enhanced Error Correction at Low Cost
problem: CXL Memory Modules have different characteristics than traditional DRAM DIMMs, making existing cache and reliability optimizations ineffective; there is a need to optimize bandwidth, enhance reliability, and reduce area overhead for CXL systems.
motivation: CXL is emerging as a key memory interconnect standard, but its full-duplex nature and features are not fully exploited by current optimization techniques.
method: Proposes three coordinated techniques: Proactively Write-back uses dead block prediction to minimize dirty cachelines, Utilization-aware Policy monitors internal CMM bandwidth and sends write-backs only during low-load periods, and Buddy ECC separates stronger ECC for dirty cachelines from weaker EDC for clean cachelines.
key_novelty: Buddy ECC scheme leveraging CXL's full-duplex capabilities to dynamically adapt error correction based on cacheline cleanliness status.
contributions: Energy consumption increase under 1% while enhancing reliability
limitations: Limitations not discussed; scalability to heterogeneous memory hierarchies unclear.
primary_theme: CXL memory optimization with adaptive error correction
